visual_thesis: A yellow courier stays distinct against navy routes and coral obstacles; compact edge UI preserves the playfield.

ref-style-01.prohibited_influence: Do not copy its subject silhouette or exact palette.

directions.name: Clear garden lanes
directions.premise: Large separated lanes and compact edge controls

structure.silhouette_or_massing: Large stepped masses establish a clear first read.
structure.composition_and_value: A bright focal band separates foreground and depth.
structure.shape_grammar: Tapered wedges repeat at primary structural joints.
structure.material_and_edge_language: Matte surfaces use deliberate hard and soft edges.
structure.lighting_and_camera: Top-left key light supports an orthographic camera.
structure.signature_motif: A split-chevron motif repeats only at hierarchy anchors.

directions.benefit: Keeps the functional focal point readable at target scale.
directions.production_feasibility: Can be built from reusable layered modules.
risks: The motif may become too repetitive without a controlled range.
directions.distinctive_difference: Open playfield with three repeated navigable lanes.
